name: handler_rpushbullet
title: Progression Handler: Progress Reported via the Pushbullet Messaging Service

origin.description: Build a progression handler that posts a Pushbullet note.
origin.usage: handler_rpushbullet(intrusiveness = getOption("progressr.intrusiveness.rpushbullet", 5), target = "gui", ..., title = "Progress update from R", recipients = NULL, email = NULL, channel = NULL, apikey = NULL, devices = NULL)

arguments.name: intrusiveness
arguments.text: How disruptive the reporter is. The default reads progressr.intrusiveness.rpushbullet, or 5.

arguments.name: target
arguments.text: Where progress is rendered. The default is "gui".

arguments.name: title
arguments.text: Note title. The default is "Progress update from R".

arguments.name: recipients, email, channel, apikey, devices
arguments.text: Optional Pushbullet routing. NULL leaves that argument out.

origin.details: requireNamespace("RPushbullet") fails with "Package RPushbullet is not available".
origin.value: A function of class progression_handler. On this machine the package lookup stops before that function is returned.
origin.example:
err <- tryCatch(handler_rpushbullet(), error = function(e) conditionMessage(e))
cat("handler_rpushbullet() errors: ", err, ".\n", sep = "")

translation.description: Build a progression handler that would post a Pushbullet note.
translation.usage: handler_rpushbullet(intrusiveness=None, target="gui", *, title="Progress update from R", recipients=None, email=None, channel=None, apikey=None, devices=None, **extra)

arguments.name: intrusiveness
arguments.text: How disruptive the reporter is. The default reads progressr.intrusiveness.rpushbullet, or 5.

arguments.name: target
arguments.text: Where progress is rendered. The default is "gui".

arguments.name: title
arguments.text: Note title. The default is "Progress update from R".

arguments.name: recipients, email, channel, apikey, devices
arguments.text: Optional Pushbullet routing. NULL leaves that argument out.

translation.details: The call stops when RPushbullet is missing. No note is posted.
translation.value: A function of class progression_handler. On this machine the package lookup stops before that function is returned.
